title: pretty JORDANE|Plus Size Cold Shoulder Sweetheart Necklin Chiffon Midi Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Feel fabulous in our Plus Size Cold Shoulder Sweetheart Neckline Chiffon Midi Wedding Guest Dress. The sweetheart neckline and cold-shoulder design bring a touch of romance, while the flowing chiffon fabric creates a flattering A-line midi silhouette. Designed for comfort and style, this dress is perfect for curvy wedding guests looking to make a statement with grace and elegance.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi Length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
